heroSection.title: Turn Questions into Clarity and Transform Responses into Valuable Insights
heroSection.text: Effortlessly build surveys that deliver the answers you need to grow, improve, and connect with your audience.

heroSection.title: Simple Smart Surveys
heroSection.text: Create surveys, share them easily, and get real feedback. Survey Land lets you build MCQs, comment boxes, and more — all in one simple platform.

missionSection.title: Our Mission
missionSection.text: At Typeform, we give forms a better look and feel—so our customers can get more out of them. Historically, forms haven't been great, but businesses need them and people can't avoid them.

teamSection.title: Join The Team
teamSection.text: Founded in 2012, Typeform is now a remote-first company with an international team of over 250 employees. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and career opportunities to support your professional growth.
